title: Germany 5-Year Bobl reopening (EUR 5.0bn, DE000BU25075) — the day before the Bund 30Y multi-ISIN auction and CPI
source: EST: two independent Deutsche Finanzagentur primaries, both fetched direct 2026-09-30 — Press Release No. 8 on 24 September 2026, "Issues planned by the Federal government in the fourth quarter of 2026" (2026_09_24_PM_08_Issues_planned_by_the_Federal_government_for_the_4th_quarter_2026.pdf, HTTP 200, 143,466 bytes), Annex 1: "Tue, 13-Oct-2026 | Bobl 5 | R | 5,000 | 08-Oct-2031 | DE000BU25075 | 2.90% | 23-Jul-2026 | 08-Oct-2027"; and the Q4 2026 issuance-outlook workbook "as of September 2026" (Issuance_outlook_2026_Update_Q4_en.xlsx, HTTP 200, 75,398 bytes), row 7: 2026-10-13, Bobl, 5 years, Reopening, EUR 5,000m, maturity 2031-10-08, DE000BU25075, coupon 2.9%. A reopening of the 5-year Bundesobligation already tapped three times this quarter (new issue 2026-07-21 at EUR 6.0bn, reopened 2026-08-11 at EUR 6.0bn and 2026-09-01 at EUR 5.5bn, per the Finanzagentur issuance-history workbook), and scheduled again 2026-11-03 (EUR 5.0bn) and 2026-12-01 (EUR 4.5bn) per the same two primaries. Discovered during bund-30y-auction-2026-10-14's 2026-09-30 pulse-check adjacency sweep, one calendar day before that auction and one day before CPI (cpi-2026-10-14, confirmed, high). Filed estimate on the same mechanical count as every German-debt-office entry on this calendar: market-events-data.ts defines no confirmed source prefix for a non-US sovereign debt office. The date, size and ISIN are not in doubt — two independent primaries agree to the decimal — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-30
notes: No tracked symbol carries euro-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed, so NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED; impact is tiered low on the same basis as every other German-debt-office entry on this calendar (bund-30y-auction-2026-10-14, jgb-5y-auction-2026-10-14). This bond's own reopening cycle is the live finding: across its four 2026 taps (07-21 new issue through 09-22) the weighted-average yield rose 2.89% -> 3.28%, bid-to-cover fell 1.5x -> 1.2x, retention rose 24.1% -> 25.3%, and the 09-22 tap was the first of the cycle to price bid-to-offer below 1.0 (0.906) -- a genuine, measured softening, not yet two consecutive misses. Finanzagentur's own forward calendar corroborates a taper: the same ISIN steps down to EUR 4.5bn on 2026-12-01 after four straight EUR 5.0bn-or-larger taps. See docs/research/events/bobl-5y-auction-2026-10-13.md for the full workup. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
